article.title: How Duco transforms financial data automation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
article.excerpt: Duco, a data automation platform for tier-one banks, rebuilt its agentic AI stack on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. With strict per-tenant isolation, a multi-model strategy, and an MCP skills architecture that cut context overhead by 90%, Duco cut reconciliation deployment time 10x and onboarding costs 70%.
